Profile Picture Maker

Turn any photo into a perfect profile picture: square center-crop with zoom, circle or square shape, a colored ring, and export at 256, 512 or 1024 px.

👤 Drop your photo here or click to browse
Set to 0 for no ring.

The crop is always centered on your photo. Files never leave your device — everything is processed in your browser.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your photo — a live preview appears instantly.
  2. Drag the zoom slider to frame your face the way you like.
  3. Pick circle or square shape, a ring color and ring width.
  4. Choose the export size (256, 512 or 1024 px) and click “Download PNG”.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I frame my face?

Move the zoom slider right to crop tighter on your face, or left to include more of the photo. The crop always stays centered.

Can I remove the ring?

Yes — set the ring width to 0 and it disappears entirely, leaving just your cropped photo.

Is my photo uploaded?

No. Your photo is cropped and drawn on a canvas in your browser — it is never uploaded anywhere.
